rules: No Emerald gym names, leaders, puzzles, scripts or map identities may be reused.
Every gym has a unique visual theme, puzzle mechanic and leader personality.
Teams are progression targets and can be tuned after playtesting.

gyms.puzzle: rotate living hedges to redirect sunlight into three seed altars
regulate furnace pressure by opening vents in the correct heat sequence
change tide gates to raise and lower walkable reef platforms
assemble magnetic rail bridges by switching polarity nodes
complete live circuits while storm pulses periodically reset inactive nodes
navigate shadow corridors where lamps reveal hidden doors but close other paths
redirect frozen wind to slide crystal blocks into thermal locks
activate four dragon runes by completing elevation trials across cliff platforms
rotate gravity rooms and predict mirrored teleport destinations
mix safe antidote compounds to cross toxic greenhouse sectors
operate mining lifts and controlled rockfalls to open alternate shafts
follow sound echoes through rooms whose doors disappear when directly observed
use directional wind cannons and sail platforms between suspended towers
reconstruct luminous street murals by matching color-symbol constellations
rotate ancient ruin rings to reroute sand streams and expose buried passages
complete four discipline trials focused on timing, observation, navigation and trainer battles
